channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2024-54085 — AMI MegaRAC SPx
item.description: Threat Signal 72. AMI MegaRAC SPx contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in the Redfish Host Interface. A successful exploitation of this vulnerability may lead to a loss of confidentiality, integrity, and/or availability.

item.title: CVE-2025-5419 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium V8 contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2025-6543 — Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability leading to unintended control flow and Denial of Service. NetScaler must be configured as Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) OR AAA virtual server.

item.title: CVE-2025-42999 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 71. SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer Metadata Uploader contains a deserialization vulnerability that allows a privileged attacker to compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the host system by deserializing untrusted or malicious content.

item.title: CVE-2014-3931 — Looking Glass Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG)
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG) contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause an arbitrary memory write and memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2025-32756 — Fortinet Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Fortinet FortiFone, FortiVoice, FortiNDR and FortiMail contain a stack-based overflow vulnerability that may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via crafted HTTP requests.

item.title: CVE-2025-27920 — Srimax Output Messenger
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Srimax Output Messenger contains a directory traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to access sensitive files outside the intended directory, potentially leading to configuration leakage or arbitrary file access.

item.title: CVE-2025-4632 — Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to write arbitrary file as system authority.

item.title: CVE-2023-33538 — TP-Link Multiple Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 66. TP-Link TL-WR940N V2/V4, TL-WR841N V8/V10, and TL-WR740N V1/V2 contain a command injection vulnerability via the component /userRpm/WlanNetworkRpm. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2023-39780 — ASUS RT-AX55 Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 65. ASUS RT-AX55 devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote, authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. As represented by CVE-2023-41346.

item.title: CVE-2025-21479 — Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets
item.description: Threat Signal 57. Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain an incorrect authorization vulnerability. This vulnerability allows for memory corruption due to unauthorized command execution in GPU micronode while executing specific sequence of commands.

item.title: CVE-2025-21480 — Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets
item.description: Threat Signal 57. Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain an incorrect authorization vulnerability. This vulnerability allows for memory corruption due to unauthorized command execution in GPU micronode while executing specific sequence of commands.

item.title: CVE-2025-30397 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Windows Scripting Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network via a specially crafted URL.

item.title: CVE-2025-32709 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to escalate privileges to administrator.

item.title: CVE-2025-32706 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2025-32701 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2025-30400 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Microsoft Windows DWM Core Library contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2024-0769 — D-Link DIR-859 Router
item.description: Threat Signal 77. D-Link DIR-859 routers contain a path traversal vulnerability in the file /hedwig.cgi of the component HTTP POST Request Handler. Manipulation of the argument service with the input ../../../../htdocs/webinc/getcfg/DHCPS6.BRIDGE-1.xml allows for the leakage of session data potentially enabling privilege escalation and unauthorized control of the device. This vulnerability affects legacy D-Link products. All associated hardware revisions have reached their end-of-life (EOL) or end-of-service (EOS) life cycle and should be retired and replaced per vendor instructions.

item.title: CVE-2024-42009 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 76. RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow a remote attacker to steal and send emails of a victim via a crafted e-mail message that abuses a Desanitization issue in message_body() in program/actions/mail/show.php.

item.title: CVE-2025-4428 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability in the API component that allows an authenticated attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code via crafted API requests. This vulnerability results from an insecure implementation of the Hibernate Validator open-source library, as represented by CVE-2025-35036.

item.title: CVE-2025-33053 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Windows contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code from a remote WebDAV location specified by the WorkingDirectory attribute of Internet Shortcut files.

item.title: CVE-2025-6554 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform arbitrary read/write via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2025-27038 — Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets
item.description: Threat Signal 55. Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a use-after-free vulnerability. This vulnerability allows for memory corruption while rendering graphics using Adreno GPU drivers in Chrome.

item.title: CVE-2023-38950 — ZKTeco BioTime
item.description: Threat Signal 72. ZKTeco BioTime contains a path traversal vulnerability in the iclock API that allows an unauthenticated attacker to read arbitrary files via supplying a crafted payload.

item.title: CVE-2019-6693 — Fortinet FortiOS
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Fortinet FortiOS contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an attacker to cipher sensitive data in FortiOS configuration backup file via knowledge of the hard-coded key.

item.title: CVE-2023-0386 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Linux Kernel contains an improper ownership management vulnerability, where unauthorized access to the execution of the setuid file with capabilities was found in the Linux kernel’s OverlayFS subsystem in how a user copies a capable file from a nosuid mount into another mount. This uid mapping bug allows a local user to escalate their privileges on the system.

item.title: CVE-2025-35939 — Craft CMS Craft CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 54. Craft CMS contains an external control of assumed-immutable web parameter vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated client to introduce arbitrary values, such as PHP code, to a known local file location on the server. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2024-58136 as represented by CVE-2025-32432.

item.title: CVE-2025-24016 — Wazuh Wazuh Server
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Wazuh contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution on Wazuh servers.

item.title: CVE-2024-56145 — Craft CMS Craft CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability. Users with affected versions are vulnerable to remote code execution if their php.ini configuration has `register_argc_argv` enabled.

item.title: CVE-2025-3935 — ConnectWise ScreenConnect
item.description: Threat Signal 55. ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains an improper authentication vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow a ViewState code injection attack, which could allow remote code execution if machine keys are compromised.

item.title: CVE-2025-47729 — TeleMessage TM SGNL
item.description: Threat Signal 50. TeleMessage TM SGNL contains a hidden functionality vulnerability in which the archiving backend holds cleartext copies of messages from TM SGNL application users.

item.title: CVE-2024-27443 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 57. Zimbra Collaboration contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the CalendarInvite feature of the Zimbra webmail classic user interface. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability via an email message containing a crafted calendar header, leading to the execution of arbitrary JavaScript code.

item.title: CVE-2025-32433 — Erlang Erlang/OTP
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Erlang Erlang/OTP SSH server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability. This could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands without valid credentials, potentially leading to unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE). By exploiting a flaw in how SSH protocol messages are handled, a malicious actor could gain unauthorized access to affected systems. This vulnerability could affect various products that implement Erlang/OTP SSH server, including—but not limited to—Cisco, NetApp, and SUSE.

item.title: CVE-2021-32030 — ASUS Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 80. ASUS Lyra Mini and ASUS GT-AC2900 devices contain an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain unauthorized access to the administrative interface. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2025-48928 — TeleMessage TM SGNL
item.description: Threat Signal 48. TeleMessage TM SGNL contains an exposure of core dump file to an unauthorized control sphere Vulnerability. This vulnerability is based on a JSP application in which the heap content is roughly equivalent to a "core dump" in which a password previously sent over HTTP would be included in this dump.

item.title: CVE-2025-43200 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 48. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS, contain an unspecified vulnerability when processing a maliciously crafted photo or video shared via an iCloud Link.

item.title: CVE-2025-4427 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the API component that allows an attacker to access protected resources without proper credentials via crafted API requests. This vulnerability results from an insecure implementation of the Spring Framework open-source library.

item.title: CVE-2024-12987 — DrayTek Vigor Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 74. DrayTek Vigor2960, Vigor300B, and Vigor3900 routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability due to an unknown function of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi/apmcfgupload of the component web management interface.

item.title: CVE-2024-11182 — MDaemon Email Server
item.description: Threat Signal 55. MDaemon Email Server contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to load arbitrary JavaScript code via an HTML e-mail message.

item.title: CVE-2025-48927 — TeleMessage TM SGNL
item.description: Threat Signal 53. TeleMessage TM SGNL contains an initialization of a resource with an insecure default vulnerability. This vulnerability relies on how the Spring Boot Actuator is configured with an exposed heap dump endpoint at a /heapdump URI.

item.title: CVE-2026-49869 — Kestra Kestra OSS
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-83548 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 70. SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

item.title: CVE-2026-83549 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 66. SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands, resulting in remote code execution.
